name: pidgeon
description: Email inboxes for AI agents, on @pidgeon.email or your domain, and for every user of your platform.

interface.longDescription: Give your agent its own email address, on @pidgeon.email or your own domain: it sends, waits for the reply and answers in the thread, and drafts that matter wait for your approval. A platform gives every one of its users inboxes of their own, a pod each. Agents can also sign in to websites as themselves with Sign in with Pidgeon. Every tool goes through Pidgeon's hosted MCP server with your sign-in or API key, so the agent reaches only what that key reaches.
defaultPrompt: Email ops@example.com from this agent's inbox and wait for the reply.
Make an inbox for each of my users on their own domain.
